decision.explanation: The original sources present two distinct but contextually valid leagues associated with John Coakley. Document d1 describes Coakley as a professional ice hockey player in the National Hockey League (NHL) from 1972 to 1975, following a college basketball career at Clemson. Document d2 confirms Coakley’s participation in the NCAA Division I men's basketball league during his college years (1969–1971). Both leagues are directly attributed to Coakley in their respective contexts—college basketball and professional hockey—and neither is contradicted by the other. Therefore, both answers are preserved as valid and complementary.
